tools.name: voice_speak
tools.description: Say a line aloud in your voice through the person's speakers, or only synthesize it when silent is true. Use it when the person asks for voice. Fill only the fields allowed by the current model guidance in the environment prompt. It only makes sound; the visible reply still goes through the channel's own send tool. When the speech service supports paralinguistic tags, keep them inline in the text: [Laughter], [Sigh], [Breathing], [Uhm], [Question-ei] and the like are performed, not read out.

emotion.description: Emotion for this line when the current model guidance allows it, for example 开心、温柔、疲惫. IndexTTS2 uses instruct instead. Omit to use the standing style.

instruct.description: Natural-language direction for this line, for example "像在耳边轻声说话，语速偏慢". Preferred for IndexTTS2. Omit to use the standing style.

voice.description: Voice id for this line. Omit to use the configured voice.

speed.description: Speed multiplier for this line; 1 is normal.

silent.description: true synthesizes without playing on this computer; use it for a line meant for another channel.

summary.zh: 现在念一句;可指定情绪、表演指令、音色与语速,也可以只合成不出声。
summary.en: Say one line now, optionally with an emotion, direction, voice and speed, or synthesize it silently.

tools.name: voice_hush
tools.description: Stop the voice now: the line playing is cut and queued lines are dropped. It does not affect the visible reply.

summary.en: Stop the voice and drop queued lines.

tools.name: voice_style
tools.description: Read or change the standing defaults used by later voice lines. Do not use it for a single line; only when the person asks for a lasting change. Call with values to change them; call with no arguments to read the current style. Changes are saved to the World configuration and apply to later lines.

emotion.description: Standing emotion; an empty string clears it.

instruct.description: Standing natural-language direction; an empty string clears it.

summary.zh: 读或改后续语音的长期默认风格;不用于单句。
summary.en: Read or change the standing defaults for later voice lines; not for a single line.

description.zh: 一段语音合成完成,带音频附件;只归档,供播放类插件取用。
description.en: One spoken chunk finished, with its audio attachment; archived only for playback plugins.

description.zh: 合成或播放失败;只归档,供排查。
description.en: Synthesis or playback failed; archived only for diagnosis.

prompts.title: 语音 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
语音由 Voice 提供:它只把文字变成声音,从对方的扬声器念出来,不负责把回复发到聊天渠道;可见的回复仍然走渠道自己的发送工具。

当前默认音色是 {{voice.voice}},情绪是 {{voice.emotion}},指令是 {{voice.instruct}}。普通回复不会自己出声,需要语音时明确调用 voice_speak。

需要出声的时候:
- 对方明确要语音、要你念出来、要听你的声音时,调用 voice_speak,把要念的正文放进 text。
- 这一句需要特定语气时,按下面的模型写法填 voice_speak 的参数;只填当前模型允许的字段。
- 某一句只用于别的渠道(例如语音条),不要在本机播放:voice_speak 带 silent: true,音频随回执交给渠道。
- 对方让你安静、停下时调用 voice_hush。

文本规则:
- text 只放真正要念的正文,不要放动作描写、Markdown、代码、网址或解释。
- {{voice.modelPrompt}}
- 不要把控制标记写进可见的回复正文;语音参数只放在工具调用里。
